service.method: SELECT USMT.USER_ID , USMT.USER_NAME_LOC , USMT.EMPLOYEE_NO , CMGL.COMPANY_NAME_LOC , DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC , CODE.TEXT1 AS "POSITION" , USMT.USER_TYPE , USMT.WORK_TYPE , USMT.EMAIL , USMT.MENU_PROFILE_CODE FROM SUSMT USMT LEFT OUTER JOIN SCMGL CMGL ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = CMGL.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.COMPANY_CODE = CMGL.COMPANY_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN SDEPT DEPT ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = DEPT.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.COMPANY_CODE = DEPT.COMPANY_CODE AND USMT.DEPT = DEPT.DEPT LEFT OUTER JOIN SCODE CODE ON CODE.HOUSE_CODE = USMT.HOUSE_CODE AND CODE.TYPE = 'M230' AND CODE.CODE = USMT.POSITION LEFT OUTER JOIN SSUGL SUGL ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = SUGL.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.COMPANY_CODE = SUGL.SELLER_CODE WHERE USMT.SIGN_STATUS = CASE WHEN ${session.USER_TYPE} = 'S' THEN USMT.SIGN_STATUS ELSE ${SIGN_STATUS} END AND USMT.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND USMT.COMPANY_CODE = CASE WHEN ${session.USER_TYPE} = 'S' THEN ${session.COMPANY_CODE} ELSE USMT.COMPANY_CODE END AND ( 1 = 1 AND USMT.USER_NAME_LOC LIKE '%' || $S{F_KEYWORD}|| '%' OR USMT.USER_ID LIKE '%' || $S{F_KEYWORD}|| '%' OR USMT.MENU_PROFILE_CODE LIKE '%' || $S{F_KEYWORD}|| '%' ) AND USMT.MENU_PROFILE_CODE IN ( $INS{F_MENU_PROFILE_CODE}) AND $S{F_STATUS} IN( 'A', USMT.USER_TYPE ) AND NVL(USMT.DEL_FLAG,'N') = 'N' ORDER BY NVL(CMGL.COMPANY_CODE,SUGL.SELLER_CODE),USMT.USER_ID
